{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check shape
print(f"Dataset shape: {df.shape}")

# Confirm no missing order_id
print(f"Missing order_id: {df['order_id'].isnull().sum()}")

# Check for sentinel values in customer_age
sentinel_count = (df['customer_age'] == -1).sum()
print(f"Number of -1 values in customer_age: {sentinel_count}")

# Check revenue column dtype and sample values
print(f"Revenue dtype: {df['revenue'].dtype}")
print(f"Sample revenue values: {df['revenue'].head().tolist()}")

# Check if revenue has thousands separators
has_commas = df['revenue'].str.contains(',', na=False).any()
print(f"Revenue contains commas: {has_commas}")"}
